// Secrets are NOT inlined — set before running: DEMO_USER
// Generated by Cairntrace `cairn export playwright`. Edit at your own risk —
// re-running export will overwrite. Source: /tmp/late-text.yml
// Intent: run tokens and secrets in waits, when, eval, fill; bound splices
// Lang: ts

import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";

/** Render a captured value like Cairntrace's runtime ${requests|evals|artifacts.…} splice. */
function cairnSplice(root: unknown, path: string[]): string {
  let value = root;
  if (value === undefined) return "";
  for (const key of path) {
    if (value !== null && typeof value === "object" && key in value) {
      value = (value as Record<string, unknown>)[key];
    } else {
      return "";
    }
  }
  if (value === undefined || value === null) return "";
  return typeof value === "object" ? JSON.stringify(value) : String(value);
}

const RUN_TOKEN = process.env.CAIRN_RUN_TOKEN ?? Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10);

test("golden_late_bound_text", async ({ page }) => {
  // Derived from sequential step/outcome budgets (+10% headroom, at least 1m); 4h ceiling.
  test.setTimeout(275000);

  // Values captured by request/eval/download `assign:` for later ${…} splices.
  let cairnRequests_created: unknown;
  let cairnEvals_state: unknown;

  // --- steps ---
  // step: go
  await page.goto("https://example.com/orders");
  // step: create
  {
    // request step (created) — page.request shares browser context cookies
    const cairnResponse = await page.request.fetch("/api/orders", { method: "POST", timeout: 30000, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, data: { "ref": `order-${RUN_TOKEN}` } });
    cairnRequests_created = { url: cairnResponse.url(), method: "POST", status: cairnResponse.status(), ok: cairnResponse.status() >= 200 && cairnResponse.status() < 400, headers: cairnResponse.headers(), body: ((text) => { if (text === null || text === undefined) { return null; } try { return JSON.parse(text) as unknown; } catch { return text; } })(await cairnResponse.text()) };
    expect(cairnResponse.status()).toBe(201);
  }
  // step: read_state
  cairnEvals_state = { value: await page.evaluate(async ({ source, args }) => {
    // Cairn eval.js is JavaScript input, so keep it outside the generated TypeScript AST.
    const AsyncFunction = Object.getPrototypeOf(async function () {}).constructor as new (...parameters: string[]) => (...values: unknown[]) => Promise<unknown>;
    const execute = new AsyncFunction("args", source);
    return await execute(args);
  }, { source: `return { id: window.__orderId, token: '${RUN_TOKEN}' };`, args: {} }) };
  // step: wait_order
  await expect.poll(async () => (await page.locator("body").innerText()).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().toLowerCase().includes(String(`Order ${RUN_TOKEN} created`).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().toLowerCase()), { timeout: 5000 }).toBe(true);
  // when: text:Welcome back process.env.DEMO_USER
  if (await page.evaluate((needle) => String(document.body?.innerText ?? "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().toLowerCase().includes(needle), String(`Welcome back ${process.env.DEMO_USER ?? ""}`).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().toLowerCase())) {
    // step: dismiss_banner
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Dismiss" }).first().click();
  }
  // step: fill_reference
  {
    for (let fillAttempt = 0; ; fillAttempt++) {
      await page.getByLabel("Reference").first().fill(`${cairnSplice(cairnRequests_created, ["body","id"])}-${RUN_TOKEN}`);
      await page.waitForTimeout(500);
      try {
        await expect(page.getByLabel("Reference").first()).toHaveValue(`${cairnSplice(cairnRequests_created, ["body","id"])}-${RUN_TOKEN}`, { timeout: 500 });
        break;
      } catch (err) {
        if (fillAttempt >= 3) throw new Error("hydration wiped value after 4 attempts", { cause: err });
      }
    }
  }
  // step: open_detail
  await page.goto(`/orders/${cairnSplice(cairnEvals_state, ["value","id"])}`);

  // --- outcomes (the contract) ---
  // detail_shows_token: detail page shows the run token
  await expect(page.locator("body")).toContainText(`${RUN_TOKEN}`, { ignoreCase: true, useInnerText: true });

});
